residence.zh: 合成城市，不对应真实地点；居住地是它的 2 个合成居住片区。
residence.en: A synthetic city, not a real place; homes are in its 2 synthetic home areas.

work.zh: 工作地是同一座合成城市的 1 个合成就业片区。
work.en: Work is in the same synthetic city's 1 synthetic work area.

note.zh: 合成资料包的模型设定（税务设定 tax.synth.e1conv），不代表任何真实城市。
note.en: Model settings of the synthetic pack (tax setting tax.synth.e1conv); it does not represent any real city.

coverage_note.zh: 全部数值是手工合成的模型设定或测试资料，没有地图位置，只能从城市列表访问。
coverage_note.en: All values are hand-made model settings or test data; there is no map position, so open it from the city list.

notes.zh: 合成城市不对应真实地点，没有地图位置（锚点为空，not_applicable），只能从城市列表访问。
notes.en: Synthetic cities are not real places and have no map position (anchor null, not_applicable); open them from the city list.

notes.zh: 这份清单不授予运行资格：能选哪些城市由能力清单与服务规则决定；没有锚点的城市仍可从城市列表访问。
notes.en: This list does not grant run eligibility: the capabilities list and service rules decide which cities can be chosen, and a city without an anchor can still be opened from the city list.
